checks: Missing/invalid/unsafe selection and unknown request fields fail before child creation or any HTTP, preserving exact parent bytes

Derived selection budget ignores inherited page count/limit, coalesces duplicate occurrences, excludes pending stale rows and rebuilds duplicate findings over retained plus fresh observations without seed/sitemap/link expansion
Explicit selected-attempt resume preserves config and parent while replacing stale success with committed 404; wrong budget kind causes no archive/state/network changes
A chosen recorded 404 becomes a new captured 200 after the fixture changes, while all four unrelated saved rows and exact failed parent snapshot remain unchanged
A selected external result never becomes a credential seed or traversal root, including a derived child used as the next source
Refreshing requested redirect A retains distinct requested B exactly, even while A captures a newer final B document
Selected pause drains the admitted target, rejects deriving an active source and recovers/resumes selected-only SQLite state without report/manifest or refetching committed selection
Crash retains immutable plan/base and inherited rows, excludes uncommitted selected old success, and explicit resume retries only pending selected identity with honest at-least-once attempt metadata

Native CLI writes new JSON/CSV/durable selected store, retains exact source and refuses parent overwrite (including an alternate hardlink), existing report/store, colliding destinations or missing target before requests
Altered inherited SQLite payload is not exposed as a validated resumable selection, and rejected recovery makes zero requests
Native API and CLI page CSVs preserve original columns and expose exact requested-URL freshness, mixed-age coverage, immutable parent hash and captured timestamp
limits: Owned native/API/CLI fixtures. Browser recrawl, provider freshness, full reference parity, exactly-once remote requests and power-loss durability require separate evidence.
